title: Barnard B005 envelope verifier CLI JSON (v1)
description: Strict stdin request and successful stdout receipt for the offline B005 verifier CLI. This receipt reports only that the envelope's signature and lease window verified for the given current ENIN; it is not evidence that the event is registered, and registration is NOT confirmed by this result.

signedEnvelopeHex.description: Lowercase hexadecimal signed envelope bytes without the four-byte B005 container (199 to 508 bytes).

currentEnin.description: ENIN supplied by the caller for offline verification; not independently established wall-clock time.

Receipt.description: This receipt reports only that the envelope's signature and lease window verified for the given current ENIN; it is not evidence that the event is registered, and registration is NOT confirmed by this result.

kind.description: This receipt reports only that the envelope's signature and lease window verified for the given current ENIN; it is not evidence that the event is registered, and registration is NOT confirmed by this result.

relayExpiresAtEnin.description: Exclusive end of the half-open relay window, not proof that the event is registered or physically present.
